endorsements.name: Arash Khazaei
endorsements.label: CVE-2014-125133
endorsements.description: NativeChurch theme for WordPress before 1.6.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to download arbitrary files through the file parameter of download.php. Attackers can send GET requests with directory traversal sequences in the file parameter to retrieve sensitive files like wp-config.php. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)

endorsements.name: Arash Khazaei
endorsements.label: CVE-2015-10144
endorsements.description: The Responsive Thumbnail Slider plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file uploads due to missing file type sanitization in the via the image uploader in versions up to 1.0.1. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to upload arbitrary files on the affected sites server using a double extension which may make remote code execution possible.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)
